title: Dedicated region proofing for tenant isolation and residency attestations
creator: Elena Torres
description: Goal: produce automated attestations and one-click evidence packages proving data residency boundaries and tenant isolation for Dedicated capacity customers. This ticket implements the server-side controls, evidence collection pipelines, and reporting endpoints that allow compliance and sales teams to generate a signed attestation (PDF + machine-readable bundle) showing: 1) the tenant's data never left the configured region, 2) network and storage isolation controls applied, 3) retention policies enforced and retention logs exported.
background: Enterprise customers require auditable proofs of residency and logical tenant isolation for contracts and regulatory reviews. Currently we have manual runbooks and ad-hoc exports; the Dedicated team needs a repeatable, verifiable flow that ties runtime routing, storage encryption, and tenant config to time-bound evidence artifacts. ENG-4721 established residency attestations prototype; this ticket completes production hardening and automation for Dedicated pools.
acceptance_criteria: A signed attestation PDF can be generated via Console and API that references the tenant ID, region, timestamp range, and list of controls evaluated
A machine-readable evidence bundle (JSON + logs/manifest) containing routing metadata, KMS key IDs, S3 object manifests, and KV-cache audit entries can be exported for a given time window
Automated retention enforcement audit shows deletions/expiry events and links to storage lifecycle confirmations
Evidence generation process is gated by RBAC and requires an approver role for any attestation older than 90 days
End-to-end tests validate that traffic routed to Dedicated pool marked eu-west-1 never appears in non-eu-west regions (simulation via trace IDs)
milestones: Design: finalize evidence schema + PDF template (Confluence: /r/Residency/attestations-v2)
Infra: add residency metadata headers to serving runtime and persist to audit log (syslog/S3)
Automation: build evidence-bundler Lambda + job to collect manifests and sign bundles
Console: UI to request/generate attestations, download bundle, and create ticket for legal review
QA: integration tests with Dedicated staging pool and simulated cross-region traffic
tasks: Add 'residency_region' and 'tenant_isolation_id' fields to runtime request metadata and propagate to audit logs
Persist per-request proofs to write-once S3 prefix with lifecycle 7 years and encrypted with tenant KMS key
Create evidence-bundler service that aggregates manifests, collects KMS master key identifiers and audit hashes, bundles logs, and creates signed payload
Implement Console endpoint /api/v1/attestations that triggers bundle creation and returns status + signed artifact URL
Add RBAC check: only users with 'compliance:attest' can request historical attestations; require 2nd approver for >90d windows
Create end-to-end test harness that injects trace IDs and asserts bundles do not contain cross-region IPs
Document runbook for legal to verify signature and JSON manifest format
notes: Security: planned KMS envelope keys per-tenant; HSM-backed signing for final artifacts
Retention policy: evidence bundles immutable, stored 7 years; storage lifecycle must be auditable
SLA: evidence generation should complete within 5 minutes for recent windows and be queued for longer ranges
